model_arch: GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM (glm_moe_dsa; DeepSeek-V3.2-DSA-class: MLA + sparse-attention indexer + fine-grained block-fp8 MoE, 78 layers, 256 experts top-8 + 1 shared, hidden 6144, 1M max ctx)
gpu: AMD gfx950 (MI350X-class, CDNA4), 8-GPU node; HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES pins shard GPUs
support_verdict: SUPPORTED on vLLM 0.25.1 (vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:latest) which registers GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM -> deepseek_v2.GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM (real impl). REQUIRES VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 (DSA sparse-attn indexer has no non-AITER ROCm path; crashes without it). Older rocm/vllm:latest (0.11.2) does NOT support it.
quantization: fp8 block (e4m3, weight_block_size [128,128], dynamic acts) auto-detected from checkpoint quantization_config; kv_cache_dtype=auto (bf16 MLA latent KV)
backends: decode ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE; prefill ROCM_AITER_FA MLA; MoE AITER Fp8 (per_1x128 block-scale fused_moe)
sanity: PASSED both TP: 'The capital of France is' -> ' Paris. Distance from Paris to Lyon is 391 km' (coherent)
caveats: aiter GEMM/MoE shapes report 'no tuned config, using default' -> UNTUNED aiter kernels for GLM shapes (a tuning sweep would improve both TP). 1024-ctx TTFT is a cold-start outlier. Not bit-exact.
